text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎收看《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收看《Real Easy English》。

text: the podcast where we have real conversations
zh: 我们进行真实对话的播客
zh_hant: 我們進行真實對話的播客

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Neil.
To watch a video version of this podcast
and download a free worksheet,
zh: 并下载一份免费的练习表,
zh_hant: 並下載一份免費的練習表,

text: go to our website - bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Neil, how are you?
Are you happy to be at work today?
Of course.
I'm always happy to be at work.
Great.
Well, today we are talking about dream jobs.
zh: 好,今天我们要谈谈梦想中的工作。
zh_hant: 好,今天我們要談談夢想中的工作。

text: Obviously, this job is amazing,
but we're going to talk about some different jobs we'd like to do.
zh: 不过我们要谈谈一些我们想从事的不同工作。
zh_hant: 不過我們要談談一些我們想從事的不同工作。

text: Sounds good.
Shall we start?
Yes.
So, Georgie, when you were a child,
what did you want to do when you grew up?
zh: 你小时候长大后想做什么?
zh_hant: 你小時候長大後想做什麼?

text: What was your dream job?
zh: 你以前的梦想职业是什么?
zh_hant: 你以前的夢想職業是什麼?

text: Well, when I was really little , about five or six.
zh: 我小时候,大概五六岁的时候。
zh_hant: 我小時候,大概五六歲的時候。

text: I remember telling people that I wanted to be a princess.
zh: 我记得自己跟别人说过,我想成为一名公主。
zh_hant: 我記得自己跟別人說過,我想成為一名公主。

text: When I realised that wasn't going to be possible for me,
zh: 我意识到这对我来说不可能实现时,
zh_hant: 我意識到這對我來說不可能實現時,

text: my next dream was to be a pop star,
zh: 我的下一个梦想是成为一名流行歌星。
zh_hant: 我的下一個夢想是成為一名流行歌星。

text: because my friends and I used to write songs
zh: 我和朋友们以前常常一起写歌
zh_hant: 我和朋友們以前常常一起寫歌

text: and perform in front of our parents,
zh: 并在我们父母面前表演,
zh_hant: 並在我們父母面前表演,

text: and I thought that would be really fun.
Yeah.
What about you?
Well, I'm kind of similar.
I think,
actually, when I was, when I was a child ,
I thought that being a professional sportsman
zh: 我以为当一名职业运动员
zh_hant: 我以為當一名職業運動員

text: would be fantastic.
Either a footballer or a cricketer.
zh: 要么是足球运动员,要么是板球运动员。
zh_hant: 要麼是足球運動員,要麼是板球運動員。

text: What went wrong?
I'm not good enough.
I learned that lesson.
So, Neil, obviously you are not a rock star.
zh: 显然,尼尔,你不是一名摇滚明星。
zh_hant: 顯然,尼爾,你不是一名搖滾明星。

text: But how or when did you decide
zh: 你是怎么决定的,又是什么时候决定的?
zh_hant: 你是怎麼決定的,又是什麼時候決定的?

text: to become an English teacher
instead?
Well, when I finished university,
I wanted to travel more than anything else.
zh: 我最想做的事情就是旅行。
zh_hant: 我最想做的事情就是旅行。

text: And I wanted to live in foreign countries,
not just go on holiday.
And I thought a good way to do that would be to become an English teacher.
zh: 我觉得成为一名英语老师是实现这个目标的好方法。
zh_hant: 我覺得成為一名英語老師是實現這個目標的好方法。

text: Yeah, I have a similar story.
It was the same thing for me.
I just wanted to live abroad.
Georgie, what is important to you about your job now?
zh: 乔治,你现在的工作对你来说重要的是什么?
zh_hant: 喬治,你現在的工作對你來說重要的是什麼?

text: Well, many of us spend a lot of our lives working.
zh: 我们中很多人一生中大部分时间都在工作。
zh_hant: 我們中很多人一生中大部分時間都在工作。

text: So for me, it's really important
zh: 对我来说,这真的很重要
zh_hant: 對我來說,這真的很重要

text: to enjoy the day.
We work nine to five.
It's a lot of hours in the day.
It's really important to me to have a nice team
zh: 这个团队和睦对我来说真的很重要
zh_hant: 這個團隊和睦對我來說真的很重要

text: that you can have fun with.
It's also really important
for me to feel like
I'm giving something
good or doing a good job.
What about you?
Yeah.
I think it's important to feel
zh: 我觉得感受一下很重要
zh_hant: 我覺得感受一下很重要

text: that you're doing something useful.
zh: 你在做一件有用的事情。
zh_hant: 你在做一件有用的事情。

text: So hopefully our conversations
like this are useful for people
zh: 对像这样的东西对人们很有用
zh_hant: 對像這樣的東西對人們很有用

text: because they can learn something,
zh: 因为他们可以学到一些东西,
zh_hant: 因為他們可以學到一些東西,

text: and I like that.
Yeah.
Me too.
So, Neil, if you didn't have to worry about money
zh: 如果你不用为钱发愁,尼尔
zh_hant: 如果你不用為錢發愁,尼爾

text: or anything else,
what would your dream job be?
I think I know the answer already.
zh: 我想我已经知道答案了。
zh_hant: 我想我已經知道答案了。

text: Yeah, well, you said earlier
that I didn't become a rock star,
but there is still a future.
And, you know, if I didn't have to work ,
zh: 你知道,如果我不用工作的话,
zh_hant: 你知道,如果我不用工作的話,

text: I could just follow my dream.
zh: 我可以就这样追随自己的梦想。
zh_hant: 我可以就這樣追隨自己的夢想。

text: How about you?
I think
if I didn't do this job ,
I would like to be a travel photographer
zh: 我想成为一名旅行摄影师。
zh_hant: 我想成為一名旅行攝影師。

text: or someone
that makes documentaries.
I really love those nature documentaries,
zh: 我真的很喜欢那些自然纪录片。
zh_hant: 我真的很喜歡那些自然紀錄片。

text: and it would be very fun to be involved in those.
Yes, that sounds like it would be amazing.
OK, let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
zh: 好,我们来回顾一下对话中听到的语言表达。
zh_hant: 好,我們來回顧一下對話中聽到的語言表達。

text: We talked about our dream jobs
zh: 我们聊了聊各自梦想中的工作。
zh_hant: 我們聊了聊各自夢想中的工作。

text: when we were children using the structure when I was younger,
zh: 我们小时候,就像“when I was younger”这种结构一样,
zh_hant: 我們小時候,就像“when I was younger”這種結構一樣,

text: I wanted to be...
So, for example, when I was younger, I wanted to be a footballer.
zh: 比如说,我小时候想当足球运动员。
zh_hant: 比如說,我小時候想當足球運動員。

text: And we talked about our dream jobs now using conditionals.
zh: 我们现在用条件句聊了聊自己梦想中的工作。
zh_hant: 我們現在用條件句聊了聊自己夢想中的工作。

text: So for example, if I could do any job ,
I would be a travel photographer.
zh: 我会成为一名旅行摄影师。
zh_hant: 我會成為一名旅行攝影師。

text: And when we're talking about jobs,
we can do them, or we can be them.
zh: 我们可以模仿他们,也可以成为他们。
zh_hant: 我們可以模仿他們,也可以成為他們。

text: For example, I teach English,
or I am an English teacher.
zh: 或者我是一名英语老师。
zh_hant: 或者我是一名英語老師。

text: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 《Real Easy English》这期节目就到这里。
zh_hant: 《Real Easy English》這期節目就到這裡。

text: If you like our programmes, why not sign up to our email newsletter?
zh: 如果你喜欢我们的节目,不妨订阅我们的邮件通讯吧。
zh_hant: 如果你喜歡我們的節目,不妨訂閱我們的郵件通訊吧。

text: You can get suggestions for other English lessons you might enjoy.
zh: 你可以获得其他你可能会喜欢的英语课程的推荐。
zh_hant: 你可以獲得其他你可能會喜歡的英語課程的推薦。

text: There's a link in the notes for this programme.
zh: 节目笔记里有一个链接。
zh_hant: 節目筆記裡有一個連結。

text: Next time we'll talk about lunch.
zh: 下次我们再谈午饭的事。
zh_hant: 下次我們再談午飯的事。

text: Join us again.
Bye.
